rule: only validated runs are promoted here; collect jobs write runs/<commit>/ and never touch this directory

cjh-grid.jsonl.range: 400-1850 C x tau 0.01-10 s, CH4:CO2=1:1, 1 atm, const-pressure CSTR, GRI-Mech 3.0
cjh-grid.jsonl.validation: 200 seeded off-node points vs fresh Cantera over the FULL 400-1850 C range: p95 |dX| = 0.00033, max 0.00062 (gate 0.02) -- run 33017155560. The earlier 400-1400-only pass (p95 0.0005, run 33015864752) is superseded by this one.

design-physical.jsonl.overlap_resolved: 89 shared design indices kept from the relabelled set (identical transients, same labelling method)
design-physical.jsonl.labels: memory_gain = outflow-weighted X_dyn / outflow-weighted quasi-steady blend; element peaks within the 1800 C materials-trust bound
design-physical.jsonl.validation: quasi-steady limit closes at 1.02 under this definition (10 s period); element drive reproduced bit-for-bit against apps/rphcjh/solver.js before relabelling

closure-diagnostic.jsonl.validation: five periods x two closures; the 10 s anomaly is resolved by the weighted baseline, not by the closure

training_split_note: draw train/val/holdout from design-physical.jsonl with a fixed seed; the historic 128/32/32 split assumed 192 rows and must be redrawn

frozen.statement: training reads exactly these three files at these digests; any change to them restarts model selection
